evidence.title: StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models
Cross-Domain, Multi-Task Data-to-Text Generation without In-Domain Training Data
A Scalable Cross-Domain Event Extraction System via a Unified Generative Training Framework
A Multi-Domain and Multi-Task Generative Framework with Explicit Task and Domain Conditioning for Cross-Domain Event Extraction

summary: Researchers introduced a scalable generative training framework that conditions on explicit task and domain signals, allowing a single model to perform event extraction and data‑to‑text generation across unseen domains without in‑domain training data. Experiments demonstrate state‑of‑the‑art results on several benchmarks, including explicit strategy induction tasks.
title: New Unified Generative Framework Enables Cross‑Domain, Multi‑Task Event Extraction and Data‑to‑Text Generation
